title: EDAM Participants Release Draft Plan for RA Program

meta.summary:
A stakeholder group representing present and future participants in CAISO’s Extended Day-Ahead Market has released its “initial” draft proposal for a resource adequacy program designed to accommodate the needs of EDAM’s non-CAISO members. 
 The post  EDAM Participants Release Draft Plan for RA Program  appeared first on  RTO Insider .
